entries.speaker: 詩(ラヴェンツァ)
entries.en: Thou hast fallen, thy soul reduced to ashes.

entries.speaker: 詩(ラヴェンツァ)
entries.en: The blazing defiance that once[n]guided thee hath been quenched[n]by a mirage's maelstrom.

entries.speaker: 詩(ラヴェンツァ)
entries.en: And thus, the hero meeteth his end,[n]his passing marked by a dying flame's vigil...
